title: build: use buildah DiscoverContainerfile for default discovery
body:
Reuse buildah's SecureJoin-based Containerfile/Dockerfile lookup so podman build matches buildah#6886 (no following symlinks outside the build context). Drop the related buildah-bud skips/errmsg workarounds.

Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/issues/6861
Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28749

Depends on: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/pull/30131
